name: Kano Masataka
source:
A young man who works as the dormitory manager. He comes across and both good-natured and relaxed, and is skilled in a wide variety of chores, and is an excellent cook. Due to this, he has a positive reputation with the students in the dorm.

The truth is that he is a bit crazy. He has an abnormal fascination with breast milk. He even developed a drug that can make woman lactate without pregnancy. He plans to use it on the students in the dorm he manages.
